'''Orman''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chev]] businessman who lived on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. He had extensive black market connections, and was an occasional [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Like many Chev who had escaped [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], he expressed the individuality which would normally have been suppressed by a [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] master by dyeing his [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and skin in bright [[Color/Legends|colors]]&mdash;in his case, his skin was iridescent blue and his hair was silver. He was also always accompanied by a group of thugs who acted as bodyguards&mdash;possibly due to the common fear free Chevs had of being forced back into bondage.

==Behind the scenes==
In Orman's character template, his species is given incorrectly as [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]].
